Weekly guest services notes. The pool closes at nine on weekdays and at ten on weekends. Towels are at the pool desk. The lobby bar has live music on Friday. Breakfast runs from seven to half past ten in the garden room. The spa is closed on Monday for maintenance. Parking is free for guests on weekends. Late checkout until two costs twenty five euros. The gym is on the first floor. Housekeeping starts at nine and ends at four.
